Priya A.: Sofia accepted (Sr Data Eng). Start 2026-04-01. Portugal payroll cutoff 3/29 so first salary hits 4/30. Request: one-time onboarding advance = 50% monthly base payable in first payroll window, and temporary +1 comp band for 90 days while relocation completes. Need approvals and tax guidance.

Ruth (People Ops): Quick flags: cross-border advance affects withholding. Recommend clawback: 'repayable if employment terminates within 90 days'. Exec sponsor needed for uplift.

Leo (Hiring Manager): I sponsor the +1 band for 90 days. 90-day clawback fine.

Priya A.: Prefer advance instead of signing bonus. Will amend offer if approved.

Finance Bot: payroll-calc PT for 50% monthly advance: est net ~46% of monthly after withholding. Recommend decision on gross-up.

Ruth (People Ops): Routing to comp-committee + finance for vote: 1) approve 50% onboarding advance, 2) approve temporary +1 band for 90 days with 30-day check-in, 3) approve clawback language. Will update offer and notify payroll if approved.

Priya A.: Thanks, standing by to send amended offer tonight if greenlit.

Leo (Hiring Manager): Appreciate fast turn. :thumbsup:
